items.question: Can newborn Emiratis apply for an electronic return document through the UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs?
items.gold: Yes, the electronic return document service is also available for newborn Emiratis.
items.fact: Electronic return document available to newborn Emiratis too

items.question: Which UAE body supervises the emergency line for Emiratis abroad?
items.gold: The National Affairs Department supervises the emergency line, in coordination with UAE missions abroad.
items.fact: National Affairs Department supervises Emiratis abroad emergency line
